question: Where is museum located within 60 kilometers along the route from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ to Nautical Mile, Freeport, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Nautical Mile%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Freeport%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 60000 ) );
